fields.acceptance: A Go test with injected git and make: a moved origin/main fetches, fast-forwards and runs make update once; an unmoved one runs nothing; a pending start delays it to a later poll; a dirty checkout or a failing make update is logged and not retried until origin/main moves again; with selfUpdate off nothing runs; rhiza daemon settings lists rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate = false (default)
fields.statement: With the setting rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate on (off by default, shown and edited in the autonomy app), when origin/main has moved past the main checkout the daemon, at the end of a poll with no start pending, fast-forwards the main checkout and runs make update there, so its re-exec on a changed binary takes over; a dirty or diverged checkout or a failing make update is logged and skipped until main moves again

fields.acceptance: A testscript: daemon status --json carries the running daemon's version; health --json reports the daemon part warn naming both commits when origin/main is ahead of it, and ok when they match
fields.statement: rhiza daemon status shows the commit the running daemon was built from, and rhiza health warns on its daemon part when origin/main is ahead of that commit
